generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
The amount put to tender is Exclusive of GST and the tenderer should quote without GST. However, GST will be paid at prevailing Rate during billing.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Increase in GST shall not be paid in extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time.

Successful bidders should execute the agreement within 20 days from the date of approval intimated. If the contractor fails to enter into the agreement within the said period, the EMD of the contractor shall be forfeited and action shall be initiated for banning to participate in the tender of KBJNL.

The earnest money deposit may be forfeited a) if the Tenderer withdraws the Tender after tender opening during the period of tender validity b) if the Tenderer does not accept the correction of the Tender Price, pursuant to Clause 13.60 or c) in the case of a successful Tenderer, if the Tenderer fails within the specified time limit to i) sign the Agreement or ii) furnish the required Security deposit.
The earnest money deposit of unsuccessful tenderers will be returned within 30 days of the end of the tender validity period specified in DTP.

technicalCriterionList.description: List of Financial Resources with Certificates

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period. i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. Satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value), as prime contractor, at least one similar work such as Overhauling, servicing and supply of spares and re-erection of Pump in Major LIS Headwork/Jackwell of capacity 1439 KW and above of value not less than Rs.72.97 Lakhs. (Usually not less than 50% of Estimated Value of Contract) (Updated to the FY in which the tenders are invited. The value of the completed works shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of FY in which the tenders are invited and the necessary work done certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer / Equivalent officer of the concerned division and counter signed by the Superintending Engineer of the same circle or equivalent in case of other Government under taking within India)

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period. i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. To qualify for award of this contract, Executed in any one financial year, for the following minimum quantities of work (Usually 80% of the peak annual rate of construction) - Efficiently Improvement, Energy conversation and long term corrosion protection in pumping systems by way of fluiglide coating including dry compressed air at 6 to 7 Kg / cm2 and 350 CFM and by abrasive blasting as per SSPC SP-10 standard (SA 2.5) for surface preparation, supply of the fluiglide series at 1.20 mm DFT coating material, application of the fluiglide series 1.20 mm DFT coating material on wetted parts of hydraulic components to the specified coating thickness, dynamic balancing impeller, inspection of coating for dry film thickness and hydraulic components including spark test and conducting performance tests (Corro coat only) - 2 Jobs

Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under, assessed available tender capacity - (AxNx1.5 - B) Where A - Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years at 2026-27 price level (updated to the financial year in which the tender is invited) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N - Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited - 0.75 Years (9 Months), B - Value at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on going works to be completed during the next 09 Months (Period of completion of the works for which tenders are invited).
